info.title: Doseph API
info.summary: The REST API of Doseph, the mixing robot for nutrient solution
info.description: The web app on the device and other apps use only this API. Every text is a message with a key (`Msg`). Sign in with the password for a session cookie, or send an access token as `Authorization: Bearer`. `x-roles` names who may call an operation (SD-129): `owner` is a session signed in with the password; `app`, `account` and `peer` are the roles of access tokens. A call outside its role is refused with 403. Writing calls from a browser must come from the same origin. The simulator adds `/sim` calls of its own; the device has none. Over MQTT (SD-130) the device takes four commands on doseph/<device ID>/{stop,recipe,ec_target,ph_target}/set, as calls of the account role.

session.name: dp_session
session.description: Set by signing in with the password; the owner's role

token.description: An access token (`dpt_…`) with its role (SD-129)

text.description: The English text; the app shows the key's text in its own language

Msg.description: A message by key, with its values (every text the robot sends is one)

deviceId.description: The device's own identity (SD-129): random, made at the first start, never in a backup

labelCode.description: The setup code is the one on the device's label, taken only in the function key's window (SD-149)

keyWindow.description: The function key's window is open: 5 min after a short press (SD-149)

board.description: The board description: signed by the maker, or one of the owner's own (SD-141)

selfTest.description: Whether the device tests its protection at every start, or a person checks it by hand (SD-141)

used.description: The last use since the start

token.description: Shown only now; the robot keeps its hash

device.description: "" on this device; the coupled device's ID for a canister on its channel (SD-131)

reportOnly.description: The locks a person releases that only report: their latch alarms as before and holds nothing (SD-133). Leak, high level and the cable check always lock.

NetDevice.description: A network device added by its address (SD-132)

RoleBinding.description: What a role is bound to: a Shelly's switch or input, an ESPHome entity, or an MQTT topic (SD-132). An output role only on a Shelly Gen2+.

Devices.description: The network devices with what they said, and each role with its binding and its state. Never a password.

shotsPerDay.description: For a watering circuit with a time window that follows the plant (SD-134); null: the circuit's own

shotS.description: The length of a shot, s, 1 s to 24 h; never longer than the circuit's longest shot; null: the circuit's own

lightHours.description: For a light circuit that follows the plant (SD-135): hours of light, 0 to 24; null: the circuit's own

lightPct.description: For a dimmed light circuit that follows the plant: brightness, 1 to 100 %; null: the circuit's own

dayC.description: For a climate room that follows the plant: temperature by day, 5 to 40 °C; null: the room's own

nightC.description: … temperature by night, 5 to 40 °C; null: the room's own

rhPct.description: … humidity, 20 to 95 %; null: the room's own

vpdKpa.description: … a VPD, 0.2 to 2.5 kPa, which leads the humidity in place of one; null: none

co2Ppm.description: … CO2 by day, 400 to 1500 ppm; null: the room's own

Config.description: The configuration: everything a backup holds

Notify.description: Quiet hours in minutes after local midnight (SD-123)

PushSettings.description: Push channels without an account (SD-124). A secret is written, never read back: reads say only whether it is set

State.description: The live state: readings, the cycle, alarms, latches, channels, stock and more; the same body the event stream sends

how.description: device: done while the robot sees it; confirm: done once the user confirms it; later: not there yet

at.description: When the user confirmed or skipped it; 0 otherwise

Setup.description: Commissioning (SD-129): the steps of #10 in their order

complete.description: Every step is done or skipped, apart from those that come later

MqttSettings.description: MQTT with Home Assistant discovery (PD-461, SD-130). Off by default. Values go out also without TLS; commands only over TLS with a user. The password is written, never read back.

commands.description: Take commands: Stop, the recipe in force, its EC and pH targets. Needs TLS and a user.

topic.description: The device's base topic, doseph/<device ID>

status.description: The platform's report: connected, its error, when

Peer.description: The coupled device (SD-131), never with a token

role.description: What this device is in the group

address.description: Where the leader reaches the follower; empty on the follower

code.description: A pairing code shown here, with its end; the code itself only in the answer that made it

pairing.description: The last pairing from here while under way or failed: state, address, error, at

link.description: While coupled: whether the other device was heard within 10 s, when, what the follower said last, and the run asked for

maxFillMin.description: The longest fill, min (RAT-079); a fill that reaches it without the float saying full latches the refill (RAT-031)

mode.description: "mixing": during each dose, its mixing wait and a fill, never while the check measures; "always": all the time. Never during Stop, maintenance or a hold.

WaterCircuit.description: A watering circuit (SD-134): a pump or a valve on a Shelly output, bound as the role `water.<id>`

id.description: w1, w2, …; without one a new circuit is made

fromMin.description: window: its start, local minute of the day

shotS.description: window and interval: a shot's length, s

everyMin.description: interval, from local midnight; at most a day

longestS.description: No shot is longer; at most 24 h. The device's own auto-off is 1.11 × it (RAT-019).

rateLpm.description: What it gives, for the count of litres; null: not known

plant.description: window: the plant whose current phase sets shots a day and their length where it has them (SD-134); empty: none

LightCircuit.description: A light circuit (SD-135): a Shelly switch or a dimmer on a 0–10 V line, bound as the role `light.<id>`

id.description: l1, l2, …; without one a new circuit is made

startMin.description: The day's start, local minute of the day

pct.description: A dimmer's brightness by day, 1 to 100 %

thresholdPct.description: The lamp driver's switch-on threshold, 0 to 50 %; less is raised to it (RAT-013)

sunriseMin.description: A dimmer's rise from the day's start, 0 to 240 min; 15 unless set (RAT-035)

sunsetMin.description: A dimmer's fall to the day's end, 0 to 240 min; 15 unless set (RAT-035)

plant.description: A plant whose current phase sets the hours and the brightness where it has them; empty: none

id.description: r1 to r99; empty or absent: a new room

lights.description: Its light circuits, each in one room only; the first one's day is the room's

startMin.description: Without a light circuit: its day's start, local minute of the day

hours.description: Without a light circuit: its day's hours, 0 to 24

dayC.description: Temperature target by day, 5 to 40 °C; 26 unless set (RAT-009)

nightC.description: Temperature target by night, 5 to 40 °C; 22 unless set

byVpd.description: The humidity follows a VPD target and the target temperature (RAT-009)

vpdKpa.description: VPD target where it leads, 0.2 to 2.5 kPa

co2Ppm.description: CO2 target by day, 400 to 1500 ppm; null: no CO2

heatC.description: Heat protection for light: its first limit, 20 to 45 °C, above the temperature targets; the second is 2 °C higher

heaterW.description: The heater's power, 50 to 3500 W: its plug's power limit is a fifth above it (RAT-069); null: not set

circulateAlways.description: The circulation fan runs at night too

plant.description: A plant whose current phase sets the targets where it has them; empty: none

reservePct.description: What stays in the tank, of its volume (RAT-067)

PumpCalibration.description: A pump calibration by the user (SD-143)

waiting.description: The person's turn: move the intake, or enter a reading
